library.title: Your library is empty
library.text: Add the folder where your music lives, for example on your external drive.
library.dropHint: You can also drag a folder from Explorer or Finder onto this window.

inbox.title: Inbox

review.title: All up to date
review.text: Tracks with uncertain online information will appear here.

duplicates.title: Duplicates
duplicates.text: Copies of the same track will be grouped here, with the best version suggested.

health.title: Library health
health.text: Missing artwork, unreadable files, non-matching names: everything will be counted here.

quarantine.title: Quarantine is empty
quarantine.text: Set-aside files will be kept here and can be restored in one click.

playlists.title: Playlists and filters
playlists.text: Your playlists and smart filters will appear here.

folders.title: Folders
folders.text: The tree of your music folders will appear here.

library.noResultsHint: Try another search or clear the filters.
library.notAFolder: This is not an accessible folder.

table.label: Tracks
table.sortHint: Click to sort; Shift + click to sort on several columns

badges.missing: File not found: deleted or moved outside the application
badges.wav: Rekordbox will read title, artist, album, genre and comment, but not the artwork
badges.desync: The two tag blocks of this WAV (RIFF INFO and ID3) disagree

detail.title: Details
detail.hint: Select a track to see and edit its information.
detail.multipleHint: Editing several tracks at once is coming very soon.
detail.lock: Lock (no automation will change this field)
detail.coverDropHint: Or drop an image onto the window

folders.title: Library folders
folders.hint: Folders indexed by the application. External drives are recognised even if their letter or mount point changes.
folders.removeText: “{{path}}” will no longer be followed by the application. No file is deleted or moved on the drive.

errors.offline: Cannot play: drive disconnected or file not found.
errors.audio_output: No audio output available. Check your speakers or headphones.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Changes apply immediately, no restart needed.
settings.densityHint: Compact shows more tracks on screen.
settings.diagnosticHint: Copies a report (version, system, end of the log) to paste into your message. Nothing is sent automatically.
settings.writingHint: How the application writes information into your files.
settings.versionInTitle: Write the version in the title: “Title (Extended Mix)” (recommended for Rekordbox and WAV)
settings.databaseHint: A copy is made automatically every day (the last 7 are kept). You can also export it, or import a copy: it will replace the current one at the next start, after a backup.
settings.imported: Database checked: it will be put in place at the next start of the application

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.database: The application database could not be read. Your audio files are not affected. Copy the diagnostic report in Settings to report the problem.
errors.database_too_new: The database was created by a newer version of the application. Install the latest version to continue. Your audio files are not affected.
errors.database_unavailable: The database could not be opened at startup. Your settings will not be saved. Your audio files are not affected.
errors.io: The application data folder is not accessible. Check that the computer's disk has free space.
errors.invalid_setting: This setting could not be saved.
errors.internal: Internal error. Restart the application; if the problem comes back, copy the diagnostic report.
errors.settingNotSaved: The setting could not be saved.
errors.offlineFile: File not found or drive disconnected.
errors.keyring: The system keychain is not accessible.
errors.artwork: This image could not be used.

edit.failedMany: {{count}} tracks were not changed. For example: {{reason}}
edit.selectFirst: Select one or more tracks first.
edit.coverNotSquare: The image is not square: it was kept whole. Cropping is coming in phase 2.
edit.coverUnreadable: This image could not be read. Try a JPEG or PNG file.
edit.noImageInClipboard: The clipboard does not contain an image.
edit.locked: Field “{{field}}” locked: no automation will change it
edit.tagsCopied: Tags copied: select other tracks, then “Paste tags”

writeErrors.read_only: the file or drive is read-only. Check that it is not write-protected.
writeErrors.in_use: the file is open in another program. Close it and try again.
writeErrors.disk_full: the drive is full. Free up some space and try again.
writeErrors.unsupported: this format cannot be edited yet.
writeErrors.unsafe_tags: its current tags cannot be read back safely, so it was left untouched.
writeErrors.verify: the check after writing failed; the original file is intact.
writeErrors.audio_changed: the audio would have changed; the original file is intact.
writeErrors.io: file access error; the original file is intact.
writeErrors.internal: internal error; the original file is intact.
writeErrors.rename_conflict: the target name is already taken.
writeErrors.rename_reserved: this name is forbidden by Windows.
writeErrors.rename_empty: a field needed for the name is empty.
writeErrors.rename_io: the file could not be renamed; it stayed where it was.
writeErrors.move_conflict: a file with the same name already exists in this folder.
writeErrors.move_other_disk: moving between two drives is not possible yet.

rename.optionalHint: Anything in square brackets [ ] disappears when the field inside is empty. Characters forbidden by Windows or macOS are replaced automatically.
rename.conflicts: If two files would get the same name
rename.conflictSkip: Do not rename the second one
rename.longPaths_one: {{count}} path will exceed 250 characters: Rekordbox on Mac may not read it.
rename.longPaths_other: {{count}} paths will exceed 250 characters: Rekordbox on Mac may not read them.
rename.nothing: All files already have the right name.
rename.saveAs: Save this template under a name

clean.nothing: No changes: the tags are already clean.
clean.lockedHint: Locked fields are never changed by the clean-up.

rule.featToArtists: Move “feat.” from the title to the artists
rule.extractVersion: Split the version from the title (“Title (Extended Mix)”)
rule.titleCase: Capitalise each word of the title (can break stylised names)

parse.title_one: Tags from the name of {{count}} file
parse.title_other: Tags from the names of {{count}} files
parse.hint: {piste} stands for a track number, which is ignored. The name is read without its extension; “_” counts as a space.
parse.overwrite: Also replace existing values (otherwise only empty fields are filled)

move.hint: The files change folder on the drive. Nothing is overwritten: a file with the same name already there is reported and skipped.
move.problems_one: {{count}} track will not be moved (see the list).
move.problems_other: {{count}} tracks will not be moved (see the list).

onboarding.welcomeText: A few settings before you start. Everything can be changed later in Settings.
onboarding.foldersText: Choose the folder where your music lives. If it is on an external drive, plug it in now.
onboarding.inboxHint: For example your Beatport or Bandcamp downloads folder. New files there will be identified and tagged automatically.
onboarding.exfat: Tip: for a drive used on both Windows and Mac, the exFAT format is the most convenient.
onboarding.onlineText: From phase 2, the application will be able to complete your tags and artwork from MusicBrainz, Deezer and iTunes. A free AcoustID key (optional) will recognise badly named tracks. Nothing is sent without your consent.
onboarding.tip1: Organise and rename your tracks here before importing them into Rekordbox: they will never have broken links there.
onboarding.tip2: After changing tags, use “Reload Tag” in Rekordbox so it reads the files again.
onboarding.tip3: For WAV files, Rekordbox reads title, artist, album and genre, but not the artwork.

online.queued_one: {{count}} track added to the online search
online.queued_other: {{count}} tracks added to the online search
online.queuedOffline_one: Offline: the search for {{count}} track will run when the network is back
online.queuedOffline_other: Offline: the search for {{count}} tracks will run when the network is back
online.caughtUp_one: Connection restored: {{count}} pending search was done
online.caughtUp_other: Connection restored: {{count}} pending searches were done

review.emptyHint: Select tracks in the library, then “Search online” (Ctrl+L).

review.nothingFound: No results. Check the spelling or try fewer words.
review.offline: No internet connection: try again when the network is back.
review.searchFailed: The search failed. Try again in a moment.

crop.title: Crop artwork
crop.selection: Kept area (drag to move, corner to resize)
crop.hint: Drag the square to choose the part to keep; pull the bottom-right corner to make it bigger or smaller.

inbox.noFolderText: Choose the folder where your new tracks arrive (Beatport, Bandcamp downloads…). Each new file will be identified, tagged, given artwork and renamed automatically when it is safe.
inbox.rekordboxTip: A track processed here before importing it into Rekordbox will never have a broken link there.

palette.title: Command palette
palette.placeholder: Type an action or a track…

onlineSettings.title: Online search
onlineSettings.hint: The network is only used for the checked sources, and only when you start a search or a track arrives in the Inbox. Everything else works offline.

src.musicbrainz: title, artists, version, album, year, label
src.acoustid: recognises a track by its fingerprint, even badly named (key needed)

warn.deezer: Its terms forbid any local copy of the content: only enable it knowingly, for strictly personal use.
warn.itunes: Its terms reserve artwork for promoting the iTunes Store: only enable it knowingly, for strictly personal use.

onlineSettings.step2: Create your user key (required from 1 January 2027) at
onlineSettings.keyHint: Keys are stored in the system keychain (Windows Credential Manager, macOS Keychain), never in the database or the code.
onlineSettings.keySaved: Key saved in the system keychain
onlineSettings.keyError: The system keychain refused to save the key.
onlineSettings.contactHint: MusicBrainz asks for a way to contact the application (website address or e-mail). Nothing is sent while this field is empty.
onlineSettings.replaceExisting: Also replace existing values (otherwise they go to “To review”)
